'''Orrian Pearls''' are [[token]]s acquired and spent in [[Siren's Landing]]. They are that map's specific [[currency]].

== Acquisition ==

{{gathered from}}

** [[Power the northwest shrine]] (1) <small>(per event)</small>
** [[Defend the northeast shrine]] (1) <small>(per event)</small>
** [[Defend the southwest shrine]] (1) <small>(per event)</small>
** [[Defend the southeast shrine]] (1) <small>(per event)</small>
** [[Capture the beast]] (2) <small>(once per character, per day)</small>
** [[Kill the horrid illusion]] (2) <small>(once per character, per day)</small>
** [[Kill the champion wurm]] (2) <small>(once per character, per day)</small>
** [[Defeat the unchained wyvern]] (3) <small>(once per character, per day)</small>{{verify}}
** [[Abaddon's Ascent]] (3) <small>(once per character, per day)</small>
